notes.title: RADical ROACH *REMASTERED*
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/uP5AzeF.jpg

 RADical ROACH REMASTERED 

The super cockroach simulator is back! and fully remastered. 

We have decided to release the remaster for FREE for all those of you who already owned the original game RADical ROACH on steam. We have replaced the original product with this new updated version. The core of the original game is fully intact but with a much needed fresh coat of paint.

RADical ROACH Remastered features new difficulty modes, tighter controls, new achievements, a host of bug fixes and an overall re-polish with brighter and enhanced visuals.

http://i.imgur.com/5O4maQP.jpg

 CHANGES 

    Tighter roach movement controls. 
    New health bar system.
    Fixed performance issues on older machines.
    Volume slider added to options menu.
    Special can now recharge. 
    Shield recharge fade.
    Special recharge fade.
    Health regeneration. 
    Enhanced visuals.
    New pause menu.
    Larger colour palette.
    Optimized textures.
    Easy difficulty added to story mode. 
    Medium difficulty added to story mode. 
    Updated menus.
    Fixed steam screenshots not working.
    Reduced nuke flash opacity.
    Delete save data option check.
    Renamed old steam achievements.

Plus a range of other small bug fixes along the way that are not really significant enough to list.

http://i.imgur.com/yY24G00.jpg

 NEW DIFFICULTY MODES 

Despite the humor in having 1 game mode with 3 hard choices, the time has come for a change for more people to be able to enjoy the game. You can now choose from 3 different difficulties to better suit your play style and preference.

  KID MODE   
If you cant beat it like this there's no hope.

    6 HP
    Faster HP regen
    Faster shield recharge
    Faster special recharge

  FORGIVING   
A slightly calmer experience. 

    4 HP
    HP regen
    Shield recharge
    Special recharge

  CLASSIC   
The original game, HARD as hell.

    3 HP
    No HP regen
    Shield recharge
    No special recharge


http://i.imgur.com/KNhEHSi.jpg

 ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK 

The Original Soundtrack will be released in a few days and will be automatically added to everyone's account who already owns RADical ROACH Remastered.

http://i.imgur.com/wByI9A5.jpg

 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS 

    Beat on hard mode
    Beat on normal mode
    Pop the squirrel mask
    Play mantis tennis
    Secret cave
    Kill 100 mosquitoes
    Kill 5000 mosquitoes
    Kill 1000 mosquitoes
    Kill 100 poppers
    Kill 100 fire bugs


http://i.imgur.com/Xhp1kQV.jpg

 OTHER INFO 

You can keep your old save file by copying it from its existing location  C:\Users\PCNAME\AppData\Local\RADical_ROACH and pasting it to  C:\Users\PCNAME\AppData\Local\RADical_ROACH_Remaster.

Enjoy!!!
ːradroachː
